facts.business: Vinayak Vanijya Limited is a listed company with a cancelled NBFC license, currently generating revenue from business operations but without a clear stated business model in the excerpts.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The auditor highlighted three matters: (a) Company has not provided valuation report of unquoted shares as required by IND AS 109; (b) NBFC license cancelled in 2018 and appeal lost in 2020, adversely affecting operations; (c) Accounting software lacks audit trail feature.

key_risks: NBFC license cancelled since 2018 with appeal lost in 2020, adversely affecting operations
Non-compliance with IND AS 109 for valuation of unquoted investments
Accounting software lacks audit trail (edit log) facility
